note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Sanctions: no confirmed hit, but NOT verifiable as clean — the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) is JavaScript-driven and returned no query results to the fetcher, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) for the whole session. UN/EU/UK/BIS lists were not reachable either. sanctions_hit is therefore null = 'not established', not 'clear'. No adverse sanctions news surfaced in the Bing results that did return, but those results were generic corporate pages (cnh.com, cnhcapital.com, Wikipedia) and carry no evidentiary weight. Court cases: 10 matters found on Indian Kanoon (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=CNH%20Industrial%20India), spanning 2018-2026. Predominantly indirect-tax litigation (Bombay HC writs vs Union of India 2021/2022, CESTAT excise appeal 2018, CGST appeal 2018), IP/trademark enforcement as plaintiff (Tirth Agro 2019), and a cluster of commercial/dealer disputes in Delhi HC (Surinder Pal Singh 2025 and 2026, Shivdei Automobiles 2026, Arka Britton 2026). One criminal-side matter, CRL.M.C. 6936/2026, where the company is itself the PETITIONER against State (NCT of Delhi) — i.e. the company is seeking relief, not being prosecuted as an accused on the face of the record; the underlying nature is not visible from the order text and should not be characterised further. Per project rule 2 these are noted neutrally and are NOT rejection grounds: 'есть сложности'. Rating: null — CNH Industrial N.V. group-level ratings exist but I could not open the issuer's debt-ratings page (cnh.com investor pages are JS-rendered and returned 'Content cannot be found'), so no rating, agency or date is asserted here; do not treat as unrated. Regulator actions: none found beyond the tax litigation above; not exhaustively checked. RF/CIS supply: null — no evidence either way located; searches for CNH Industrial Russia exit/sanctions coverage returned only generic corporate pages, so no supply to Russia or CIS is confirmed and none is excluded. Recommend a re-run of sanctions screening (OFAC/EU/UK/BIS) and a credit-rating lookup once the search backend and JS-capable fetching are available.
